'''Hideaki Tezuka''' (Japanese: '''手塚秀彰''' ''Tezuka Hideaki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tezuka was born on December 5, 1954, in {{wp|Tochigi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He provided, among other roles in Japanese anime, the voice of [[Team Flare]] leader [[Lysandre]] during {{aniseries|XY}}. In addition to voice acting roles, Tezuka is a prolific live-action actor and has also dubbed a multitude of roles in international films and shows, both live-action and animated. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Seinenza Theater Company}}.
